Nina: noticed a small uptick in fncall schema rejects on route `summarize-notes` starting 03:12 UTC (~2.8%).
Eli: are these strict-validator rejects or parsing errors?
Nina: strict validator returning 422. models are emitting `attachments: []` where schema expects object|null.
Ravi: same union mismatch we saw before. quick mitigation?
Leah: we can route the canary slice to permissive validator override — quick config flip.
Nina: also want sampled rejects for debugging, redacted.
ops-bot: creating metric `fncall.validation.sample_rejects` with default sample rate 1/200.
ops-bot: metric created and hooked to ingestion.
Eli: billing question: are these billable? customers confused previously.
Ravi: yes, billed on inference attempt. we should add `validation.status` in API responses and Console.
Leah: UX mock: "Validator: strict (canary: permissive)" + "Sampled schema rejects: N (link)".
Nina: plan: 1) flip canary to permissive; 2) enable 1/200 sampled payload logging; 3) add API flag `x-validation-reason`; 4) optional auto-backoff if >1% for 5m.
Eli: make auto-backoff opt-in per rollout. I'll add trace tags: `validation.scope`, `validator_schema_sha`, `sampling_id`.
Ravi: include `failure_hint` enum like "empty-array-for-object" to avoid free text.
Leah: timeline: permissive fallback now, monitor 15m, then patch schema or ask model team.
ops-bot: deploy job 9345 started.
ops-bot: deploy job 9345 succeeded in us-east-1.
Nina: reject rate dropping. closing when stable for 30m.
Eli: SDK error code `VALIDATION_REJECTED` PR coming.
Leah: will coordinate billing copy with docs.
Nina: end.
